records.name: Dr. B.R. Sur Homoeopathic Medical College
records.description: Dr. B.R. Sur Homoeopathic Medical College, Hospital and Research Centre in New Delhi is one of the leading homoeopathic colleges in northern India, affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University. It offers BHMS and MD (Homoeopathy) programs with emphasis on both classical and contemporary homeopathic practice. The institution's teaching hospital sees a large number of patients daily, providing students with rich clinical training experience.

records.name: Father Muller Homoeopathic Medical College
records.description: Father Muller Homoeopathic Medical College in Mangalore is a prestigious private homoeopathic institution under Father Muller Charitable Institutions, affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences. It offers BHMS and MD (Homoeopathy) programs with excellent infrastructure, a well-stocked pharmacy, and a large teaching hospital. The college is known for its research activities and community outreach programs in homoeopathic healthcare.

records.name: RAK College of Nursing
records.description: RAK College of Nursing in New Delhi is affiliated with AIIMS and Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, offering B.Sc. Nursing, Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing, M.Sc. Nursing, and Ph.D. programs. It is one of the top nursing colleges in North India, known for its strong clinical training at major Delhi hospitals and its research-oriented curriculum. The college trains nurses for leadership roles in hospital administration, critical care, and community health.

records.name: Jamia Hamdard (Pharmacy)
records.description: Jamia Hamdard (Hamdard University) in New Delhi is a deemed university established by the Hamdard National Foundation, renowned for its Faculty of Pharmacy which is consistently ranked among India's top pharmacy schools. It offers B.Pharm., M.Pharm., Pharm.D., and Ph.D. programs and houses the Hamdard Laboratories complex, connecting academic pharmacy with industrial practice. Jamia Hamdard is also well-known for its Unani medicine programs and is a significant institution for Muslim minority education.

records.name: Bombay Veterinary College
records.description: Bombay Veterinary College in Mumbai is one of India's oldest and most reputed veterinary colleges, established in 1886, and affiliated with Maharashtra Animal and Fishery Sciences University. It offers B.V.Sc. & A.H., M.V.Sc., and Ph.D. programs with strong clinical training at Mumbai's Bai Sakarbai Dinshaw Petit Hospital for Animals and the Pinjrapole animal shelter. The college is known for its small animal practice, equine medicine, and wildlife veterinary programs.

records.name: College of Veterinary Science Hyderabad
records.description: College of Veterinary Science Rajendranagar in Hyderabad is a constituent college of P.V. Narasimha Rao Telangana Veterinary University, offering B.V.Sc. & A.H. and postgraduate programs in various veterinary specialties. It is one of the premier veterinary colleges in southern India, known for its attached teaching hospital and research work in poultry science, livestock management, and animal biotechnology. The college serves Telangana's large livestock and poultry sectors through research and extension activities.

records.name: LNJN National Institute of Criminology and Forensic Science
records.description: LNJN National Institute of Criminology and Forensic Science (NICFS) in New Delhi is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Home Affairs, offering postgraduate programs in criminology, forensic science, and police management. It provides specialized training to police officers, judicial officers, and investigators in crime scene investigation, DNA profiling, and forensic psychology. NICFS is the apex training and research institution for forensic and criminological sciences in India.

records.name: Gujarat Forensic Sciences University
records.description: Gujarat Forensic Sciences University (GFSU) in Gandhinagar is the world's first and only exclusive forensic science university, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in forensic science, cyber forensics, behavioral science, and forensic psychology. Established in 2009, it has created a new paradigm in forensic education by integrating science, law, technology, and behavioral studies. GFSU collaborates with Interpol, FBI Academy, and leading international forensic institutions and provides training to police agencies across India.

records.name: CFSL (Central Forensic Science Laboratory)
records.description: Central Forensic Science Laboratory (CFSL) Hyderabad is one of three central government forensic laboratories under the Directorate of Forensic Science Services, Ministry of Home Affairs, providing forensic analysis support to central investigative agencies including CBI, NIA, and SFIO. It offers training programs in forensic biology, document examination, cyber forensics, and forensic toxicology for law enforcement officers and forensic professionals. CFSL Hyderabad is also involved in research and development of new forensic techniques and methodologies.

records.name: Lady Hardinge Medical College
records.description: Lady Hardinge Medical College (LHMC) in New Delhi is one of India's premier women's medical colleges and a central government institution affiliated with the University of Delhi. Established in 1916, it offers MBBS and postgraduate MD/MS programs and is attached to Smt. Sucheta Kriplani Hospital and Kalawati Saran Children's Hospital. LHMC is renowned for its obstetrics, gynecology, and pediatrics departments and has produced generations of leading women physicians across India.
